en.headline: Wong reaches Asian Games men's singles tennis final
en.dek: Coleman Wong beat Uzbekistan's Sultanov to reach the final and is assured of at least silver, RTHK reported.
body: Hong Kong tennis player Coleman Wong Chak-lam reached the men's singles final at the Asian Games in Nagoya after beating Uzbekistan's Sultanov, RTHK reported at noon on Friday.
RTHK said the win put Wong in the final with at least a silver medal secured and a chance of gold. Its initial report did not give the match score.

Wong had already locked in a medal by reaching the semi-finals on Thursday, local sports reports said, making him the first Hong Kong player to reach an Asian Games singles podium. Hong Kong's previous Asian Games tennis medal was a women's doubles silver in Jakarta in 1962.

zh.headline: 黃澤林闖亞運網球男單決賽 最少奪銀
zh.dek: 港隊黃澤林擊敗烏茲別克球手蘇丹諾夫晉身決賽，香港電台指他坐銀望金。
body: 香港電台星期五中午報道，港隊網球手黃澤林在名古屋亞運男子單打四強擊敗烏茲別克的蘇丹諾夫，晉身決賽。
港台以「坐銀望金」形容這場勝仗，即黃澤林最少鎖定銀牌，並有機會爭金。該則初步報道未有列出比分。
本地體育報道指，黃澤林星期四打入四強時已鎖定獎牌，成為香港史上首位在亞運網球單打登上頒獎台的球手。香港上一次亞運網球獎牌是1962年雅加達女雙銀牌。
